method: Read-only source and independent Shapely comparisons plus one actual stored fire-campus native PNG opened with view_image; no production edits, GUI controls, engine run, altered fixtures or remote operations. Pending current whole-scene acceptance belongs to root.

findings.title: Footprint-centre metric captions are commonly inside buildings
findings.impact: Depth-tested Label3D anchors commonly lie inside solid original footprints. Mesh existence and selected-building counts do not prove that the user can read the width/depth/gap text. Hidden replacement originals mean this is a strong geometric risk, not a completed pixel-level failure diagnosis.
findings.requested_fix_or_verification: Move captions onto a visible nearby exterior anchor and inspect actual native screenshots for legibility.

findings.title: Hospital JSON edits can diverge from hardcoded constructed dimensions
findings.evidence: The design file is parsed and source-world hash checked, but setup, shell, openings, approach and viewpoint use fixed constants rather than center_xz_m/width_x_m/depth_z_m/height_m/door dimensions.
findings.impact: Current values match, but a later author can change the JSON dimensions and still load the old physical hospital. Tests currently assert declared dimensions rather than every constructed envelope dimension.
findings.requested_fix_or_verification: Reject unsupported design dimensions at setup or generate the physical dimensions from the same design.

findings.title: Axis-aligned dimensions need axis-explicit labels
findings.evidence: width_x_m/depth_z_m are the world east-west/north-south source bounding-box extents, not each rotated building facade intrinsic width/depth.
findings.requested_fix_or_verification: Root plans east-west/north-south labels plus independent oriented exterior dimensions.

findings.title: Emergency ramp extends beyond named construction parcel
findings.impact: No original obstacle or private intersection was found for either approach. Only the full body and main ramp are wholly inside the named parcel.
findings.requested_fix_or_verification: Describe the main body as parcel-contained and access ramps as bounded adjacent game approaches.

findings.title: Legacy entrance and nearest-building overlays point away from new fire campus

evidence.entrance_overlay: 입구 · 58m / 이름 없는 건물 / 왼쪽 입구
evidence.scene: Player visibly stands in front of new large red three-bay brick fire campus with two engines.

findings.impact: The large left overlay covers part of the new facade and names/directions refer to another retained source building. This can confuse the user about the entry of the facility they are standing at. It is an actual stored native-image observation, not a fresh run or a diagnosis of hospital behavior.
findings.requested_fix_or_verification: Give the new authored campus entrances precedence in nearby-entry guidance, or suppress unrelated original-building guidance when facing a new facility; inspect hospital and police native pixels too.

findings.title: Display override initially reset shared building ray-target fields
findings.evidence: Initial new guidance set building_names.current_name, current_id and current_is_targeted; entrance_wayfinding._select_target reads current_id/current_is_targeted to choose catalog target_spec. Root removed all three assignments after report. Only caption/panel visibility and position are now modified.
findings.impact: No immediate E blockage was proven because the existing <=5m nearest-door priority remained. Removing shared state writes avoids altering original look-target selection and room preparation through a visual-only override.

static_checks.existing_critical_observations: Physical sliding doors retain collision, aperture occupation prevents closing onto actors, same-world hospital keeps ordinary player ownership, whole body native occupancy query precedes construction, source footprint positions are retained, legacy fixture mistakes remain preserved.

scope_limits: The retained coordinate and geodesic audit is not an independent measurement of actual Seoul buildings.
An unchanged original hidden source footprint is not proof that replacement facade art has accurate visible width/depth.
No GTA-quality or mocap claim follows from procedural motion proportions.
No native acceptance or subjective comfort claim was made by this review.

details: Hospital setup now rejects mismatched declared dimensions, centre, footprint, entrance direction or parcel.

Metric panel now displays east-west/north-south bounds and separate oriented rectangle long/short dimensions; only a high-contrast two-building 2D readout shows numeric captions, with 1m ground grid and 2m ruler retained.
Comparison mode only hides competing visual panels, and existing source wayfinding recalculates visibility on normal process after it is disabled.
Civic guidance now leaves source current_* targeting state, catalogs and E/input owners untouched.
Hospital authored design now distinguishes parcel-contained main body from adjacent bounded game approach ramps.
followup_static_review.limits: Current whole-scene native preview02 images are pending; no new engine or GUI was run by independent reviewer.

images.notes: Actual main and emergency entrance Korean fascia text is legible. Lower caption identifies Seoul City General Hospital and the actual main reception door at 10m/front, plus E/ordinary walking instructions. No unrelated legacy entrance badge or former-Sontag nearest-building label remains.

All numeric text for Seoul Library and Seoul City Hall is legible in the high-contrast lower-left panel. East-west/north-south bounds and separate oriented long/short bounds, source versus estimated heights and 6.77m gap are visible. Original entrance pin and nearest-building panel do not cover it. Ordinary world entrance frame and 2m ruler remain visible.

native_followup_review.method: Existing native PNGs independently opened with view_image; no new engine run or OS input was used by independent reviewer. Report numeric PASS does not substitute for this image review.
